scene_01.text: Start with one sentence. [[script]] An agent writes the script, [[voice]] records the voiceover, [[engines]] picks Manim or Remotion for each scene, [[video]] and hands you the finished video.

scene_02.text: You get [[math]] animated formulas, [[sims]] live simulations, [[languages]] any language, [[subs]] and word-synced subtitles. [[title]] One prompt. One hybrid studio.
